name: mirror
description: MIRROR — an editorial theme for considered publications, in two layouts and two modes

dark_mode_logo.description: Your logo redrawn for dark backgrounds. Empty sets your publication name in the display face.

homepage_layout.description: A single lead story over a grid, or the publication masthead over a numbered list

feed_layout.description: A wide row per post with a thumbnail beside it, or a three-column grid of cards

directory_layout.description: Layout for the tag, writer and recommendation directories

page_hero.description: Opener for the About and Membership pages, and for the error page

post_layout.description: A cover photo over centred titling, or a title page with a sticky side rail

featured_tier.description: Tier name that carries the accent panel and the "Most popular" chip

newsletter_heading.description: The heading on every subscribe block

newsletter_text.default: Free members get the archive. Paid members get the interviews.
newsletter_text.description: The line under every subscribe heading
